audit_items.proof_trace: ObligationOwnerCap.id() returns self.obligation_id (the obligation's ID, not the cap's own UID), and this ID is the sole lookup key used by handle_withdraw to retrieve the obligation from the market's internal table. Because the obligation is retrieved via borrow_mut(obligation_id), the returned object's ID equals cap.obligation_id by table-lookup invariant — there is no separate 'obligation' parameter that could diverge. An additional market_id check (obligation.market_id() == market.id) prevents cross-market misuse.
